emptyState.step2Body: We check whether ChatGPT, Perplexity and other major AI engines mention you.

onboarding.emptyHint: Nothing yet. You can skip this.
onboarding.introLede: We find the brand from its domain, then ask you to confirm the name people actually use. Measurement has not started yet.
onboarding.introWhyBody: Some tools ask ten questions at signup, but the more you ask, the more there is to get wrong. We infer industry and target market from your domain and show you why we decided that way. If it is wrong, fix it right there.
onboarding.introEngines: We measure ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini alongside Naver, Daum and HyperCLOVA. No matter which market you pick, none of these are dropped.
onboarding.scopeTitle: What market and category are you in?
onboarding.scopeLede: Market and industry shape prompts, competitors and entity disambiguation. Confirm the inferred context.
onboarding.scopeLowConfidence: Confidence is low, so please double-check.
onboarding.scopeEnginesNote: Whichever you pick, the AI engines stay the same — ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Naver, Daum and HyperCLOVA. This choice only shapes which channels we recommend.
onboarding.industryHint: This prevents a school, song or work with the same name from being counted as your brand and keeps comparisons in your category.
onboarding.aliasTitle: We also go by these names
onboarding.aliasLede: AI answers may call {brand} by other names. Add whatever comes to mind.
onboarding.aliasWhyBody: AI refers to the same brand in both Korean and English. Counting the two spellings separately makes your brand look less visible than it is. List them here and we count them as one.
onboarding.competitorTitle: You are compared against these brands
onboarding.competitorLede: We've pre-filled competitors AI identified. Remove any that don't fit.
onboarding.competitorLedeEmpty: Add the brands you want to compare against. You can leave this empty and move on.
onboarding.competitorLoading: Finding real competitors using the industry you confirmed…
onboarding.competitorWhyBody: We use it to merge Korean and English spellings when counting competitors in AI answers. It never hides competitors that are missing from this list — we still show the ones you did not know about.
onboarding.doneStarted: Measurement has already started. It usually takes 1-3 minutes.
onboarding.doneRateLimited: You already measured today. You can see the existing results on your dashboard.
onboarding.doneFailed: Your brand was registered but measurement could not start. You can retry from the dashboard.
onboarding.readyLede: We save the settings you confirmed, then start the first real measurement. The next screen keeps showing the real state and where results will appear.
onboarding.doneAsideBody: We show server-reported queued, running and completed states instead of a fabricated percentage.
onboarding.measureQueue: When the request is accepted, we show its job ID and start time.
onboarding.measureQuery: The status refreshes while questions run across each AI engine.
onboarding.measureResult: When complete, the same result appears on the dashboard and in measurement history.
onboarding.measureStarted: Your first measurement has started. Follow its live status.
onboarding.measureRateLimited: We'll take you to the measurement that already exists.
onboarding.measureFailed: Your settings were saved, but measurement could not start.
onboarding.measureFailedHint: You can retry from Brand & measurement.
onboarding.donePreviewLabel: Example screen · not your real results
onboarding.donePreviewCaption: Once measurements build up, you'll see visibility trends like this

onboarding.featureCompareDesc: Compare how often AI mentions you versus competitors

onboarding.editorCompetitorHint: Competitors missing from this list are never hidden — we only use it to merge spellings.

content.emptyTitle: No content has been created yet
content.emptyDescription: Complete a brand measurement to create the first draft from its latest content action and measured evidence.
content.editorDescription: Review the measurement basis and correct anything exaggerated or unverifiable before approval.
content.excerptLabel: Summary shown in listings and search
content.seoTitleLabel: SEO title · defaults to article title
content.moderationWaiting: The editorial team is reviewing the full article and evidence. It remains hidden from search until publication.
content.moderationDescription: Review new publishers and quality warnings before public publication.
content.moderationEmpty: No content is waiting for editorial moderation.
content.moderationConfirm: I reviewed the full article, measurement evidence, and original sources.

siteAudit.metaDescription: Inspect the evidence that shows whether a site is technically accessible and understandable to AI search engines.
siteAudit.title: Can AI read your website?
siteAudit.description: Inspect real site responses from robots.txt to structured data. This audit covers technical readiness; whether AI actually mentions your brand is measured separately.
siteAudit.formHint: Checks public responses and up to 10 pages, then measures Google mobile performance. A complete audit can take about a minute.
siteAudit.autoQueued: The audit for the domain entered during signup is queued.
siteAudit.autoProcessing: We are checking the live site response. Results will update automatically when complete.
siteAudit.autoCompleted: This is the latest saved measurement for your domain.
siteAudit.autoFailed: The automatic audit could not be completed.
siteAudit.pageSpeedUnavailable: Google PageSpeed measurement could not be completed. Direct response measurements remain available.
siteAudit.findingsDescription: Ordered by likely impact on indexing and crawlability.
siteAudit.crawlDescription: Checks live responses for up to 10 URLs found through homepage links and the sitemap.

non_2xx.title: Non-successful page response
non_2xx.advice: Fix errors and redirects so important URLs return HTTP 2xx.

noindex.title: Page blocked from indexing
noindex.advice: Remove noindex from meta robots or X-Robots-Tag when the page should be public.

canonical_missing.title: Canonical missing
canonical_missing.advice: Declare the preferred URL on each page to avoid duplicate URL ambiguity.

canonical_mismatch.title: Canonical mismatch
canonical_mismatch.advice: Verify that the page does not unintentionally declare another URL as canonical.

schema_invalid.title: Invalid JSON-LD
schema_invalid.advice: Correct the JSON syntax and verify it again with Rich Results Test.

schema_required_missing.title: Structured-data fields missing
schema_required_missing.advice: Add required properties that match the content visitors can actually see.

title_missing.title: Page title missing
title_missing.advice: Write a unique title that clearly describes the page topic and brand.

h1_missing.title: H1 missing
h1_missing.advice: Add a primary H1 that states the page topic in one clear sentence.

broken_internal_link.title: Broken internal link
broken_internal_link.advice: Replace internal URLs that return errors or redirect them to the correct live page.

thin_article_content.title: Thin evidence in an article
thin_article_content.advice: Add a direct answer, examples, data, and enough detail to substantively cover the topic.

citation_sources_missing.title: External evidence links missing
citation_sources_missing.advice: Link directly to primary statistics, research, and official sources that support the article.

author_signal_missing.title: Author or publication signals missing
author_signal_missing.advice: Expose the author name and profile plus publication and modification dates to readers and machines.

slow_ttfb.title: Slow first response
slow_ttfb.advice: Review caching, CDN, and server queries to bring TTFB below 800ms.

slow_response.title: Slow HTML response
slow_response.advice: Optimize server rendering and response size to bring the complete response below 2.5 seconds.

siteAudit.noScoreTitle: Readiness and actual AI visibility are different metrics
siteAudit.noScoreBody: This view does not fabricate a composite score. llms.txt is shown as information because it is not a universal standard. Measure ChatGPT and Perplexity answers separately under Brand & measurement.
siteAudit.lockedDescription: Inspect whether AI search bots can access your site and whether machines can understand its content, backed by real response evidence.
lockedBullets: Check GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot and PerplexityBot access
Inspect title, description, H1, canonical and JSON-LD structure
Show observed evidence and fixes instead of a synthetic percentage

errors.PLAN_REQUIRED: This feature is available on Growth.

errors.BRAND_DOMAIN_MISMATCH: You can audit only the registered brand domain. Update the brand domain first if it has changed.
errors.RUNNING: An audit is already running for this brand.

errors.URL_DNS: The domain could not be resolved.
errors.FETCH_TIMEOUT: The site took too long to respond, so the inspection stopped.
errors.FETCH_FAILED: The site could not be reached.
errors.RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE: The homepage response is larger than the inspection limit.
errors.REDIRECT_FAILED: The site has too many redirects or an invalid destination.
errors.NOT_HTML: The homepage did not return an HTML document.
errors.UNKNOWN: An unexpected error occurred. Try again shortly.

https.title: HTTPS connection
https.advice: Serve every public page over HTTPS and redirect HTTP requests to the matching secure URL.

status.title: Homepage response
status.advice: The primary URL should return HTTP 2xx without requiring a login or showing an error page.

robots.title: robots.txt
robots.advice: Return a valid robots.txt and make sure important public content is not blocked accidentally.

aiBots.title: Major AI bot access
aiBots.advice: Choose access rules for each AI bot deliberately. Avoid blocking core pages when AI search visibility is the goal.

sitemap.title: XML sitemap
sitemap.advice: Publish a sitemap.xml with current canonical URLs and declare its location in robots.txt.

title.title: Page title
title.advice: Use a unique title that clearly describes the page topic and brand.

description.title: Meta description
description.advice: Write a concise, specific description of who the page helps and what it answers.

h1.title: Primary H1
h1.advice: Use one clear H1 that states the primary topic of the page.

canonical.title: Canonical URL
canonical.advice: When duplicate URLs exist, declare a canonical link to the preferred address.

jsonLd.title: JSON-LD structured data
jsonLd.advice: Add valid Organization, Product, Article or other relevant schemas that match visible page content.

language.title: Document language
language.advice: Declare the page's primary language with a lang attribute on the html element. For example, lang="en".

viewport.title: Mobile viewport
viewport.advice: Provide a viewport meta tag for mobile-width screens and do not restrict zoom.

openGraph.title: Share preview metadata
openGraph.advice: Provide og:title, og:description and og:image so share previews stay consistent.

serverContent.title: Content in server HTML
serverContent.advice: Include essential copy in the server response instead of revealing it only after JavaScript runs.

semanticHtml.title: Semantic HTML structure
semanticHtml.advice: Separate primary content and navigation with meaningful elements such as main, article and headings.

trustLinks.title: Company and policy information
trustLinks.advice: Link to company details, contact information, privacy policy and terms so the operator is verifiable.

freshness.title: Modification date signal
freshness.advice: For time-sensitive content, provide a visible date plus machine-readable datetime or metadata.

llmsTxt.title: llms.txt information
llmsTxt.advice: You may publish this guide file, but it does not guarantee AI visibility and is excluded from evaluation totals.

exportDialog.includeSources: Include cited sources (URLs the AI cited as evidence)
